title: Chipotle: Simplicity as the Recipe for Success - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 02]
summary: Its significant growth is tied to its simple restaurant decor and efficient operations. In this Business Breakdown, we discuss Chipotle's origin stories, its hyper growth, its focus on simplicity, and its ability to innovate.
